items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Ed Harden was the first piano player he had.

ctx.x: 41 West 31st Street. Ed Harden was the first piano player he had. And I was corresponding with a friend of mine that plays beyond in Louisville, named Taylor, Will Taylor. He's a New York guy. He ended up a good musician. He studied music in quite a good arranger around New York. That was before Benny Carter.
